Hi Allison — thanks for sending these over and for the clear remittance example. Quick notes/actions from our side: 

- Received W-9 and ACH form (we'll store on the vendor record).
- Procurement/PayOps (cc'd) need either the full EIN (can be redacted in thread) or an official bank letter if the ACH will be initiated by a third-party processor.
- Our platform supports ACH Addenda with structured remittance. Preferable mapping is: PO number in the addenda plus invoice reference in the ACH description. If you can send sample ACH payload or confirm that your processor can place the PO in addenda field, that will speed up automation.
- For new vendors we run micro-deposit verification: PayOps will initiate two micro-deposits (random amounts) to the account on file and ask you to confirm amounts. This typically adds 1–2 business days. If you'd prefer to provide a bank letter (on bank letterhead) we can expedite with a manual review.

Can you provide:
1) confirmation whether your payments will include PO in ACH addenda, or if not, your preferred remittance layout;
2) whether the ACH is direct from Coppertrail bank account or via a payment processor (Stripe/TSYS/etc).
